transcription.text: >> Hi, everybody. My name is Marvin, and I own Groundwork Exploring in Phoenix, Arizona.
I've been in business for over 30 years, and I have done my shift of marketing, and I just
joined stone systems, and thus far it has been fantastic. They are taking very good
care of me. Specifically, I want to shout out to Ashley. Ashley, you're wonderful. Thank
you for your grace, thank you for your patience, thank you for being able to teach an old dog
some new tricks, and I'm learning. I'm learning a lot along the way, and I'm very, very, very
excited for the future. So, in a short amount of time, there's already buzz with my company.
I'm already seeing new interests in Groundwork Exploring, and that's really what I signed
on for. So, Ashley, stone systems, everybody over there, thank you very much. Looking forward
to the future, and let's grow together. Thank you so much. Bye-bye.
